purpose: A deployed history can accept the delayed session as an append-only dated message. Test whether chronological memory repair helps against this cheaper baseline on all 16 existing development queries. Both use the full original 512-token suffix and the same dated late entry. Run exact replay, scalar repair, blind append and explicitly dated append. Independent lifecycle per policy, deterministic within-question random order. Gold scoring after execution.
gate: Keep investigating chronological repair only if gold exact and token F1 match replay, at least two more correctly answered than each append variant, and complete lifecycle positions <=.80 of exact replay. Do not promote on score computed against false time ordering alone. No held-out evidence.
resource_repair: Restart every policy and question with the same bounded 128-token history prefill and a 64 MiB free-array cache. End-of-query logits and decoding remain identical code. The full-prefill attempt was interrupted during local swap growth and is excluded from timing.
